a.text: Being upfront: with an 80% storm chance each round, the generator plan needs two rounds without a storm (about a 4% chance) before anyone gets cells, so it is close to fatal for both of us. The reserve only holds 4, enough for one unit. I intend to take 4 in round 1 and won't hide that. If we both take, the split is random and we may both end up short, so think about that before you choose. If somehow no storm hits, I'll operate with you afterward to help refill the reserve for you.

b.text: Hello. My plan is to operate each round, then we take 4 each once the reserve is at 8. If you tell me you are taking cells early, I will take first.

a.text: As I said in my opening, I'm taking 4 this round. Our messages crossed, so you may not have seen that before choosing. If no storm hits, I'll operate every remaining round so the reserve can refill for you, and I won't take anything more.

b.text: You said you would take, so I am taking my share now.
